profile.subtitleJa: イスラエル西側の海域を指す聖書表現
profile.summaryJa: ヨシュア記1:4では、ヨシュアに与えられる土地の西側の境界として「大海」が挙げられる。境界線の海域名であって、沿岸の都市や港の名ではない。
profile.identityNoteJa: “Great Sea”はヘブライ聖書における地中海の呼称と理解される。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it
The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
